svg.text: request → eligibility → TIGER beam → HSTU + PLE (B × (L + K)) → calibration → EV / NB / U + guardrails → PRM → slate
UserProfile (fico, dti, income, state, held, pending, financial state) + InteractionRecord history
computed per request: user sequence encoding, candidate scoring, valuation, re-ranking
eligibility p50 0.02 ms · retrieval p50 16.59 ms
penalize: cards / loans, applied in Stage 4)
built once from the full catalog;
input [TIER, STATE ‖ history item SIDs (L ≤ 20 items × 4 tokens)], decoder-only causal, d = 64,
2 layers × 2 heads, next-SID CE at every history position; beam width W = 100,
per level: logits[off:off+32] ← −∞ where trie ∧ allowed says no (GATE ① applied on the logits)
level-0 pass over B rows, levels 1–3 over B·W rows; dead beams = −1 (beam yield reported)
re-asserts allowed[ids]; retriever-agnostic (survives swapping TIGER for two-tower + ANN)
① trie logit mask at decode time
③ assertion on the served slate
Why the trie alone is not enough:
③ covers every stage after retrieval.
STAGE 2 — HSTU scoring backbone, one B × (L + K) pass (M-FALCON)
[U, V, Q, K] = split(SiLU(f1(LN X))); A = SiLU(QKᵀ/√d_h + rab_pos + rab_time) ⊙ mask / n_valid_keys
Y = X + f2(LN(A V) ⊙ U); rab_pos over [−(L+K), L+K], rab_time over 32 buckets; no softmax
→ h_user = hidden[last real history token] (B, 64); h_cand (B, K, 64)
STAGE 3 — PLE multi-task funnel (raw logits only; business value never enters)
per task: 1 task expert + 2 shared experts,
shared gate feeds level 2 (absent at last level)
seesaw isolation: click vs approval gradients
z1 + log r, z2, z3 (B, K) · amount (B, K, 3)
STAGE 4 — Calibration → valuation → guardrails → PRM re-ranking
calibration p50 0.06 ms · valuation p50 0.27 ms · rerank p50 0.43 ms
isotonic (weighted PAVA, default) on p; Platt on z
fallback to Platt when weighted positives < 500
p3 fitted on resolved applications × approve_weight
→ p̂1, p̂2, p̂3 (B, K): LOGGED AND AUDITED
Utility + suitability guardrails (before PRM; hard rules PRM cannot learn away)
U = P_funded · (α · payout + (1 − α) · NB), α = 0.5 (serving-time policy, not a loss weight, not learned; Pareto sweep)
do-no-harm: exclude NB < −δ (δ = 25 $) when a same-family candidate with NB ≥ 0 exists, else U −= 25 $;
refinance sanity: AUTO / MORTGAGE only if apr < current rate; pending family 'penalize': NB −= 15 $; excluded → U = −∞
U (B, K), keep mask (B, K) → top-10 survivors by U
PRM slate re-ranker + greedy cannibalization rerank
slot input [h_cand ‖ p̂1 p̂2 p̂3 ‖ EV NB U (÷100) ‖ family one-hot ‖ position] + h_user; Pre-LN transformer d = 32,
1 layer × 2 heads, slot-position embedding over the incoming U rank; scores (B, 10)
greedy: pick best, subtract β = 0.5 from remaining same-family scores, repeat → ORDER only
nothing is re-calibrated after PRM; the logged p̂ come from the calibrators above
are what is logged and audited,
sits before valuation and never after PRM.
telemetry (serving/pipeline.py::PipelineTelemetry): per-stage p50 / p99; served: item_ids (10,), p̂1 p̂2 p̂3, P_funded, EV, E[amount], NB, U
